item.title: Roadworks at Highbury Grove, 2nd November
item.description:
The road has been closed since July creating severe disruption and additional cost to myself. Buses dont work so have to reply on ubers or bikes when coming back, particularly at night or if it is raining. The end date has been pushed back and have not received any clear information about the works, the time it will take. It is one of the main roads of Highbury and should not have been closed for that long! Please brief residents properly and make sure the work is done timely. It is cold now and this situation is very annoying

item.title: Council dead tree falling in my 92 year old mother’s garden on new fence., 2nd November
item.description:
My mother’s garden is newly fenced off from Bromley Palace Park snd it cost 3k of her own money when it really should have been done by council as people and stray dogs came into get garden and the original fence, which completely rotted away, was the council’s. Now, a large, dying council tree is gradually falling apart on her new fence and if it or a large branch falls on my mother it would be fatal. She walks to the end of the garden each day and has mild dementia. Please can you chop the large dying branches off as there are more about to fall. She lives at 85 Murray Ave BR1 3DJ but please don’t knock on her door but call me, her daughter, as she is old and confused. Many thanks 07815 122815 Mrs Gillian Hall.
